text:
Roe v. Wade is highly controversial because the Court recognized a constitutional right to abortion and limited state bans before viability, which supporters see as protecting bodily autonomy and opponents see as denying protection to unborn life and exceeding the judicial role. The majority grounded that right in Fourteenth Amendment liberty rather than explicit constitutional text, while expressly declining to decide when life begins and still using contested medical judgments about maternal health and viability. Those moral and constitutional disputes shaped American politics for fifty years until Dobbs overruled Roe in 2022 and returned abortion regulation to elected legislatures.

CONFIDENCE: 90
